newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed as market digests results.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed as market digests results.

text.p: Leading British shares opened mixed on Wednesday after the release of a string of company results at the start of trade and with Wall Street failing to provide a firm lead overnight, traders said.
By 0738 GMT the FTSE 100 had edged 2.1 points lower to 3,914.0 as the market digested interim figures from Prudential, Mirror Group, and Kingfisher among others.

Wall Street's overnight performance provided no clear direction, with shares there making little progress after the UK market's close on Tuesday, and it was left to company results to dictate the early trading pattern in London.
